title: Unable to change DynamicISF Adjustment Factor % Value
symptom: After upgrading from 3.2.0.4 to 3.3.1.0, the user cannot adjust the DynamicISF Adjustment Factor % Value in OpenAPS SMB preferences. After inputting a new value and clicking OK, it continues to show the old value.
cause: The issue was caused by a bug that occurred when downgrading from 3.3 to 3.2, activating the dynisf plugin and adjusting the factor, then upgrading back to 3.3. The bug was fixed by a specific commit.
fix: The fix is to apply the commit 7c000911068903ed7477c1fcb9d80dc88a893baf, which resolves the issue. A workaround is to uninstall and reinstall AAPS, import settings, and do a full sync with NSClientv3.
